name: Azure AI Foundry — Agents, Models & Cost
description: Monitor Azure AI Foundry agents, model calls, tools, tokens and cost from OpenTelemetry GenAI spans.

rawConfiguration.text:
Monitors **Azure AI Foundry** agents and model deployments from OpenTelemetry GenAI spans (`gen_ai.*`).

- **invoke_agent** spans are agent runs
- **chat** spans are model calls
- **execute_tool** spans are tool calls

Pick one or more services with the **Service** selector at the top. The search bar narrows further by agent, model or any other attribute. Cost uses built-in per-model prices; see the *Tokens & cost* page.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT filter(count(*), WHERE gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent') AS 'Agent runs', filter(count(*), WHERE gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content')) AS 'Model calls', filter(count(*), WHERE gen_ai.operation.name = 'execute_tool') AS 'Tool calls', filter(count(*), WHERE gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent' AND otel.status_code = 'ERROR') * 100 / filter(count(*), WHERE gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent') AS 'Agent error %', filter(percentile(duration.ms / 1000, 95), WHERE gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent') AS 'Agent run p95 (s)' FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IS NOT NULL
SELECT count(*) FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IS NOT NULL FACET gen_ai.operation.name TIMESERIES AUTO
SELECT count(*) FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent' FACET gen_ai.agent.name

SELECT average(duration.ms / 1000) AS 'average', percentile(duration.ms / 1000, 95) AS 'p95' FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent' FACET gen_ai.agent.name

widgets.title: Model calls per agent run — loops show up here

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT filter(count(*), WHERE gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content')) / filter(count(*), WHERE gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent') FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IS NOT NULL TIMESERIES AUTO

SELECT count(*) AS 'runs', average(duration.ms / 1000) AS 'avg seconds', percentage(count(*), WHERE otel.status_code = 'ERROR') AS 'error %' FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent' FACET gen_ai.agent.name AS 'agent'

SELECT latest(timestamp) AS 'time', latest(service.name) AS 'service', latest(duration.ms / 1000) AS 'seconds', latest(otel.status_code) AS 'status', latest(gen_ai.conversation.id) AS 'conversation', latest(service.version) AS 'release', latest(trace.id) AS 'trace' FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent' FACET gen_ai.agent.name AS 'agent', span.id LIMIT 25

SELECT filter(sum(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens * if(gen_ai.request.model = 'gpt-5-mini', 0.25, if(gen_ai.request.model = 'gpt-5.4-mini', 0.75, if(gen_ai.request.model = 'gpt-5-nano', 0.05, if(gen_ai.request.model = 'Mistral-Large-3', 0.5, if(gen_ai.request.model = 'Kimi-K2.6', 1.045, if(gen_ai.request.model = 'DeepSeek-V3.2', 0.58, {{inputPrice}})))))) + gen_ai.usage.output_tokens * if(gen_ai.request.model = 'gpt-5-mini', 2.0, if(gen_ai.request.model = 'gpt-5.4-mini', 4.5, if(gen_ai.request.model = 'gpt-5-nano', 0.4, if(gen_ai.request.model = 'Mistral-Large-3', 1.5, if(gen_ai.request.model = 'Kimi-K2.6', 4.4, if(gen_ai.request.model = 'DeepSeek-V3.2', 1.68, {{outputPrice}}))))))), WHERE gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content')) / 1000000 AS 'est. cost (USD)', filter(count(*), WHERE gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content')) AS 'model calls', filter(count(*), WHERE gen_ai.operation.name = 'execute_tool') AS 'tool calls', filter(count(*), WHERE otel.status_code = 'ERROR') AS 'errors', filter(sum(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens + gen_ai.usage.output_tokens), WHERE gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content')) AS 'tokens' FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IS NOT NULL FACET trace.id AS 'trace' LIMIT 25

SELECT count(*) AS 'calls', average(duration.ms / 1000) AS 'avg s', percentile(duration.ms / 1000, 95) AS 'p95 s', percentage(count(*), WHERE otel.status_code = 'ERROR') AS 'error %', average(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens) AS 'avg input tokens', average(gen_ai.usage.output_tokens) AS 'avg output tokens', sum(gen_ai.usage.reasoning.output_tokens) * 100 / sum(gen_ai.usage.output_tokens) AS 'reasoning % of output' FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content') FACET gen_ai.request.model AS 'model'

SELECT percentile(duration.ms / 1000, 95) FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content') FACET gen_ai.request.model TIMESERIES AUTO

widgets.title: Model call errors (%) — throttling shows here first

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE otel.status_code = 'ERROR') FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content') FACET gen_ai.request.model TIMESERIES AUTO

widgets.title: Output tokens per second, by model

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT sum(gen_ai.usage.output_tokens) / (sum(duration.ms) / 1000) FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content') FACET gen_ai.request.model
SELECT count(*) FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content') FACET gen_ai.request.model TIMESERIES AUTO

SELECT count(*) FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content') AND gen_ai.response.finish_reasons IS NOT NULL FACET capture(gen_ai.response.finish_reasons, r'\["(?P<reason>[^"]+)"\]') AS 'finish reason'
SELECT count(*) FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content') FACET gen_ai.provider.name

SELECT count(*) AS 'calls', percentage(count(*), WHERE otel.status_code = 'ERROR') AS 'error %', average(duration.ms) AS 'avg ms', percentile(duration.ms, 95) AS 'p95 ms' FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'execute_tool' FACET gen_ai.tool.name AS 'tool'
SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE otel.status_code = 'ERROR') FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'execute_tool' FACET gen_ai.tool.name TIMESERIES AUTO
SELECT percentile(duration.ms, 95) FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'execute_tool' FACET gen_ai.tool.name TIMESERIES AUTO

SELECT filter(count(*), WHERE gen_ai.operation.name = 'execute_tool') / filter(count(*), WHERE gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent') FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IS NOT NULL TIMESERIES AUTO

SELECT timestamp, service.name, gen_ai.tool.name, error.type, otel.status_description, trace.id FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'execute_tool' AND otel.status_code = 'ERROR' LIMIT 25

widgets.title: Recent tool calls — arguments and results

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT timestamp, service.name, gen_ai.tool.name AS 'tool', gen_ai.tool.call.arguments AS 'arguments', gen_ai.tool.call.result AS 'result', duration.ms, otel.status_code AS 'status' FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'execute_tool' LIMIT 25

SELECT count(*) AS 'errors', latest(otel.status_description) AS 'example message' FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'execute_tool' AND otel.status_code = 'ERROR' FACET gen_ai.tool.name AS 'tool', error.type AS 'error type' LIMIT 20

SELECT sum(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens * if(gen_ai.request.model = 'gpt-5-mini', 0.25, if(gen_ai.request.model = 'gpt-5.4-mini', 0.75, if(gen_ai.request.model = 'gpt-5-nano', 0.05, if(gen_ai.request.model = 'Mistral-Large-3', 0.5, if(gen_ai.request.model = 'Kimi-K2.6', 1.045, if(gen_ai.request.model = 'DeepSeek-V3.2', 0.58, {{inputPrice}})))))) + gen_ai.usage.output_tokens * if(gen_ai.request.model = 'gpt-5-mini', 2.0, if(gen_ai.request.model = 'gpt-5.4-mini', 4.5, if(gen_ai.request.model = 'gpt-5-nano', 0.4, if(gen_ai.request.model = 'Mistral-Large-3', 1.5, if(gen_ai.request.model = 'Kimi-K2.6', 4.4, if(gen_ai.request.model = 'DeepSeek-V3.2', 1.68, {{outputPrice}}))))))) / 1000000 AS 'Cost (USD)', sum(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens) AS 'Input tokens', sum(gen_ai.usage.output_tokens) AS 'Output tokens', (sum(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens) + sum(gen_ai.usage.output_tokens)) / filter(count(*), WHERE gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content')) AS 'Tokens / call' FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content')

rawConfiguration.text:
Cost = input tokens × input price + output tokens × output price, per million tokens, **by model**.

Built-in prices (Azure Global Standard, from the Azure Retail Prices API, 2026-10-05):

| Model | Input | Output |
|---|---|---|
| `gpt-5-mini` | $0.25 | $2.0 |
| `gpt-5.4-mini` | $0.75 | $4.5 |
| `gpt-5-nano` | $0.05 | $0.4 |
| `Mistral-Large-3` | $0.5 | $1.5 |
| `Kimi-K2.6` | $1.045 | $4.4 |
| `DeepSeek-V3.2` | $0.58 | $1.68 |

Any other model costs **$0** until you type fallback prices in the variables at the top (they default to 0, so no invented numbers). The *Models without a built-in price* table lists them. To add a model or update a price, edit the `if(gen_ai.request.model = …)` lists in the cost widgets. Reasoning tokens are billed as output.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT sum(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens) AS 'input', sum(gen_ai.usage.output_tokens) AS 'output' FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content') FACET gen_ai.request.model TIMESERIES AUTO

SELECT sum(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens * if(gen_ai.request.model = 'gpt-5-mini', 0.25, if(gen_ai.request.model = 'gpt-5.4-mini', 0.75, if(gen_ai.request.model = 'gpt-5-nano', 0.05, if(gen_ai.request.model = 'Mistral-Large-3', 0.5, if(gen_ai.request.model = 'Kimi-K2.6', 1.045, if(gen_ai.request.model = 'DeepSeek-V3.2', 0.58, {{inputPrice}})))))) + gen_ai.usage.output_tokens * if(gen_ai.request.model = 'gpt-5-mini', 2.0, if(gen_ai.request.model = 'gpt-5.4-mini', 4.5, if(gen_ai.request.model = 'gpt-5-nano', 0.4, if(gen_ai.request.model = 'Mistral-Large-3', 1.5, if(gen_ai.request.model = 'Kimi-K2.6', 4.4, if(gen_ai.request.model = 'DeepSeek-V3.2', 1.68, {{outputPrice}}))))))) / 1000000 AS 'Cost (USD)' FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content') TIMESERIES AUTO

widgets.title: Input vs output tokens, by model

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT sum(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens) AS 'input', sum(gen_ai.usage.output_tokens) AS 'output' FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content') FACET gen_ai.request.model

widgets.title: Prompt size: input tokens per model call, by model

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens) FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content') FACET gen_ai.request.model TIMESERIES AUTO

widgets.title: Where output tokens go: reasoning vs answer

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT sum(gen_ai.usage.reasoning.output_tokens) AS 'reasoning', sum(gen_ai.usage.output_tokens) - sum(gen_ai.usage.reasoning.output_tokens) AS 'answer' FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content') FACET gen_ai.request.model

widgets.title: Recent model calls with token usage

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT timestamp, service.name, gen_ai.request.model, gen_ai.usage.input_tokens AS 'input', gen_ai.usage.output_tokens AS 'output', duration.ms / 1000 AS 'seconds', trace.id FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content') AND gen_ai.usage.input_tokens IS NOT NULL LIMIT 25

widgets.title: Prompt cache: share of input tokens read from cache (%)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT sum(gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens) * 100 / sum(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens) FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content') FACET gen_ai.request.model TIMESERIES AUTO

SELECT sum(gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens) AS 'Read from cache', sum(gen_ai.usage.cache_creation.input_tokens) AS 'Written to cache' FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content')

SELECT sum(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens * if(gen_ai.request.model = 'gpt-5-mini', 0.25, if(gen_ai.request.model = 'gpt-5.4-mini', 0.75, if(gen_ai.request.model = 'gpt-5-nano', 0.05, if(gen_ai.request.model = 'Mistral-Large-3', 0.5, if(gen_ai.request.model = 'Kimi-K2.6', 1.045, if(gen_ai.request.model = 'DeepSeek-V3.2', 0.58, {{inputPrice}})))))) + gen_ai.usage.output_tokens * if(gen_ai.request.model = 'gpt-5-mini', 2.0, if(gen_ai.request.model = 'gpt-5.4-mini', 4.5, if(gen_ai.request.model = 'gpt-5-nano', 0.4, if(gen_ai.request.model = 'Mistral-Large-3', 1.5, if(gen_ai.request.model = 'Kimi-K2.6', 4.4, if(gen_ai.request.model = 'DeepSeek-V3.2', 1.68, {{outputPrice}}))))))) / 1000000 AS 'Cost (USD)' FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content') FACET gen_ai.request.model

SELECT count(*) AS 'calls', sum(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens) AS 'input tokens', sum(gen_ai.usage.output_tokens) AS 'output tokens' FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content') AND gen_ai.request.model NOT IN ('gpt-5-mini', 'gpt-5.4-mini', 'gpt-5-nano', 'Mistral-Large-3', 'Kimi-K2.6', 'DeepSeek-V3.2') FACET gen_ai.request.model AS 'model'

SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE otel.status_code = 'ERROR') AS 'Error % (all operations)', filter(count(*), WHERE gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content') AND otel.status_code = 'ERROR') AS 'Failed model calls', filter(count(*), WHERE gen_ai.operation.name = 'execute_tool' AND otel.status_code = 'ERROR') AS 'Failed tool calls', filter(count(*), WHERE gen_ai.response.finish_reasons LIKE '%content_filter%') AS 'Content-filtered' FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IS NOT NULL

rawConfiguration.text:
Failures and safety signals taken from span status, `error.type` and the model's `finish_reasons`. **content_filter** means the Foundry content filter stopped or changed a response.

Quality scores such as groundedness need an evaluation step in your app; add them as a widget if your app records them.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE otel.status_code = 'ERROR') FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IS NOT NULL FACET gen_ai.operation.name TIMESERIES AUTO
SELECT count(*) FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IS NOT NULL AND otel.status_code = 'ERROR' FACET error.type

SELECT filter(count(*), WHERE gen_ai.response.finish_reasons LIKE '%content_filter%') FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content') FACET gen_ai.request.model TIMESERIES AUTO

SELECT timestamp, service.name, gen_ai.operation.name, gen_ai.request.model, gen_ai.agent.name, gen_ai.tool.name, error.type, otel.status_description, trace.id FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IS NOT NULL AND otel.status_code = 'ERROR' LIMIT 25

SELECT count(*) FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IS NOT NULL AND otel.status_code = 'ERROR' FACET cases(WHERE error.type = 'RateLimitError' OR otel.status_description LIKE '%429%' OR otel.status_description LIKE '%rate limit%' AS 'Throttled (429)', WHERE otel.status_description LIKE '%overloaded%' OR otel.status_description LIKE '%infrastructure error%' OR otel.status_description LIKE '%model deployment encountered%' AS 'Model service error', WHERE otel.status_description LIKE '%onnect%' AS 'Connection error', WHERE otel.status_description LIKE '%invalid_request_error%' OR error.type = 'BadRequestError' AS 'Invalid request (400)', WHERE otel.status_description LIKE '%maximum token limit%' OR gen_ai.response.finish_reasons LIKE '%length%' AS 'Hit max tokens', WHERE otel.status_description LIKE '%Concurrent invocations%' AS 'Concurrency limit', WHERE gen_ai.operation.name = 'execute_tool' AS 'Tool or app code error', WHERE otel.status_code = 'ERROR' AS 'Other')

SELECT count(*) FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IS NOT NULL AND otel.status_code = 'ERROR' FACET cases(WHERE error.type = 'RateLimitError' OR otel.status_description LIKE '%429%' OR otel.status_description LIKE '%rate limit%' AS 'Throttled (429)', WHERE otel.status_description LIKE '%overloaded%' OR otel.status_description LIKE '%infrastructure error%' OR otel.status_description LIKE '%model deployment encountered%' AS 'Model service error', WHERE otel.status_description LIKE '%onnect%' AS 'Connection error', WHERE otel.status_description LIKE '%invalid_request_error%' OR error.type = 'BadRequestError' AS 'Invalid request (400)', WHERE otel.status_description LIKE '%maximum token limit%' OR gen_ai.response.finish_reasons LIKE '%length%' AS 'Hit max tokens', WHERE otel.status_description LIKE '%Concurrent invocations%' AS 'Concurrency limit', WHERE gen_ai.operation.name = 'execute_tool' AS 'Tool or app code error', WHERE otel.status_code = 'ERROR' AS 'Other') TIMESERIES AUTO
SELECT percentile(duration.ms / 1000, 95) FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent' FACET service.version TIMESERIES AUTO
SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE otel.status_code = 'ERROR') FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IS NOT NULL FACET service.version TIMESERIES AUTO

widgets.title: Tokens per model call, by release

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT (sum(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens) + sum(gen_ai.usage.output_tokens)) / count(*) FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content') FACET service.version TIMESERIES AUTO
SELECT count(*) FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content') FACET gen_ai.request.model TIMESERIES AUTO

widgets.title: Tool calls per agent run, by release

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT filter(count(*), WHERE gen_ai.operation.name = 'execute_tool') / filter(count(*), WHERE gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent') FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IS NOT NULL FACET service.version TIMESERIES AUTO

SELECT filter(percentile(duration.ms / 1000, 95), WHERE gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent') AS 'Agent run p95 s', percentage(count(*), WHERE otel.status_code = 'ERROR') AS 'Error %', filter(sum(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens + gen_ai.usage.output_tokens), WHERE gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content')) AS 'Tokens' FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IS NOT NULL COMPARE WITH 1 day ago
SELECT timestamp, entity.name, version, description, user FROM Deployment WHERE entity.name IN ({{service}}) LIMIT 25
SELECT count(*) FROM Span WHERE trace.id IN (SELECT trace.id FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent' LIMIT MAX) FACET entity.name
SELECT percentile(duration.ms / 1000, 95) FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name = 'invoke_agent' FACET service.name TIMESERIES AUTO
SELECT average(duration.ms / 1000) FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IS NOT NULL FACET gen_ai.operation.name

widgets.title: Model calls throttled or failed, by model

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT filter(count(*), WHERE otel.status_code = 'ERROR') FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content') FACET gen_ai.request.model TIMESERIES AUTO

SELECT count(*) AS 'calls', average(duration.ms / 1000) AS 'avg s', percentile(duration.ms / 1000, 95) AS 'p95 s', percentage(count(*), WHERE otel.status_code = 'ERROR') AS 'error %' FROM Span WHERE service.name IN ({{service}}) AND gen_ai.operation.name IN ('chat', 'text_completion', 'generate_content') AND k8s.pod.name IS NOT NULL FACET k8s.namespace.name AS 'namespace', k8s.pod.name AS 'pod' LIMIT 20

nrqlQuery.query: FROM Span SELECT uniques(service.name) WHERE gen_ai.operation.name IS NOT NULL SINCE 1 week ago LIMIT MAX
